summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the execution of a Letter of Intent for the development of powered land in Alberta for AI/HPC data center infrastructure. No definitive agreement, financial terms, or special-situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, going-private) are disclosed. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 describes a business development initiative but does not constitute a change-of-control, tender offer, restructuring, or other event listed in the special-situations categories. As a routine update about operational expansion, this filing is classified as None.
